resharper_csharp_blank_lines_before_block_statements #

Blank lines in code — Before statements with child blocks. Measured, and it is not the reading of the name: a bare { … } is NOT one — it is a block, not a statement with a block — and neither is a local function, while switch is one although its braces hold sections rather than a block. if, while, for, foreach, do, try, using, lock, fixed, checked and unsafe are, whenever a brace is actually present.

Typeinteger
Default0
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two

resharper_csharp_blank_lines_before_control_transfer_statements #

Blank lines in code — Before statements with control transfer. Measured: return, break, continue, goto, throw and both yield forms, and an if that embeds one of them without braces — if (a) return 1; takes the blank above the if and if (a) { return 1; } takes none. The first statement of a case section is not a subject; that gap is blank_lines_after_case's.

Typeinteger
Default0

resharper_csharp_blank_lines_before_multiline_statements #

Blank lines in code — Before multiline statements. Measured: multiline is a property of the OUTPUT, so new[] { 1, 2, 3 } written over five lines is a single-line statement here — place_simple_initializer_on_single_line joins it — while if (a) return 1; else p++; is multiline although no brace is involved.
